name: Umklammerung
description: You wrap yourself around a creature, trying to squeeze the life from them. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and is grappled. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a {save}. On your subsequent turns, while you are grappling a creature with this move, you can activate it again as a bonus action, with an automatic hit, dealing 1d4 {type} damage.
